# moodle_section_label (Resource)

Creates a Label (Textfeld) activity in a Moodle course section. Labels display HTML text directly in the course page without requiring a click-through.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "moodle_section_label" "intro" {
  course_id   = moodle_course.example.id
  section     = moodle_course_section.label.section
  name        = "Welcome"
  description = "<h3>Welcome to the course!</h3><p>Please read the materials below before starting the assignment.</p>"
  visible     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `course_id` (Number) The ID of the course to which the Label is added.
- `description` (String) HTML content of the label that is displayed directly in the course section.
- `section` (Number) The section number (0-based) in which the Label is placed.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Internal name of the label (not displayed to students). Defaults to an empty string.
- `previous_element_id` (Number) Course Module ID of the element before which this label should be inserted. Use 0 to append at the end of the section.
- `visible` (Boolean) Whether the label is visible to students. Default: true.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The Course Module ID (cmID) of the created Label.
